title: Understanding PCA Components
text: To find the component score of the first principal component, you need to use the matrices U, S, and V from the PCA results.

title: Matrix Multiplication
text: The component scores are calculated by multiplying the matrices U, S, and V. Specifically, you need to focus on the first column of the resulting matrix from U*S.

title: Calculating the First Component Score
text: Multiply the first row of U by the first value in S (which is 4) to get the first component score.
